summary: Barclays Bank PLC filed a Form 6-K to publish its Q1 2026 Pillar 3 Report, a routine regulatory capital and liquidity disclosure required by the UK’s Prudential Regulation Authority. The filing reports a solo-consolidated CET1 ratio of 12.3%, LCR of 147.4%, and UK leverage ratio of 5.4%. This is a standard quarterly capital adequacy update, not a special situation transaction or corporate event. The summary provides no terms, recommendations, or structural changes. The document is available on Barclays’ investor relations website. No action or event triggers risk-arb or activist considerations.
